recommended_policy.content:
# Example only. keystonectl prints this file and never merges it into your policy.
# The box does not check roles: whoever the policy lets call tracker_creds_* manages
# everyone's accounts in this box. Do not give a non-administrator role tracker_* :
# it also matches tracker_creds_*.
version: "2.0.0"
default_deny: true
roles:
  tracker_reader:
    description: "Read Example Tracker through the tracker box."
    allow:
      - tracker_whoami
      - tracker_get_issue
      - tracker_search_issues
      - tracker_creds_whoami
      - tracker_creds_providers
  tracker_writer:
    description: "Read and change Example Tracker through the tracker box."
    allow:
      - tracker_whoami
      - tracker_get_issue
      - tracker_search_issues
      - tracker_create_issue
      - tracker_delete_issue
      - tracker_creds_whoami
      - tracker_creds_providers
  tracker_box_admin:
    description: "Manage accounts and bindings in the tracker box."
    allow:
      - "tracker_creds_*"
critical_tools:
  - tracker_delete_issue
  - tracker_creds_profile_create
  - tracker_creds_profile_rotate
  - tracker_creds_profile_delete
  - tracker_creds_bind
  - tracker_creds_unbind
# Only a signed-in person may change accounts; API keys and service accounts may not.
requires_human_identity:
  - tracker_creds_profile_create
  - tracker_creds_profile_rotate
  - tracker_creds_profile_delete
  - tracker_creds_bind
  - tracker_creds_unbind
